high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Google search results page on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top left corner is 10:16, and the battery level is at 53%. The search query entered in the search bar is "obama care policy." The search results page shows a snippet of information about the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (PPACA), commonly referred to as "ObamaCare." The text explains that ObamaCare is a healthcare law passed by President Barack Obama in 2014. It aims to provide locals with reasonable medical insurance and raise the quality of health insurance in the USA.
